hero.title: Audit-ready AML screening.
hero.subhead: Klirs is an open-source screening workflow for compliance buyers. Every screening carries timestamped source-page screenshots, a transparent risk score, and pre-filled documentation.

audit.title: Read every line that produced your evidence.
audit.quote: Read, run, and audit every line that produced your evidence.

forWhom.title: Who Klirs is for.
forWhom.advokatiBody: Documentation pre-filled from each screening. Drop straight into the client file.
forWhom.complianceBody: EU + UN + US + UK sanctions plus PEP and adverse media in one screening. Timestamped evidence trail your auditor will accept 18 months later.
forWhom.vaspBody: Onboarding-grade screening at the speed your queue demands.

registers.title: Anchored in compliance reality.
registers.body: Data sources: FID consolidated sanctions (via Firmas.lv), VID PNP, VID VAD, Latvian Business Register (Uzņēmumu reģistrs), OFAC SDN, UK Sanctions, multilingual adverse media (LV / EN / RU / ET). Aligned with EU AML6.

features.title: What every screening produces.
features.evidenceBody: Viewport screenshot + source URL for every check. Exported as a PDF + DOCX bundle a regulator will accept 18 months later.
features.coverageBody: OFAC SDN, UK Sanctions, EU/UN/AU consolidated, Latvian PEP / officials’ declarations, Latvian Business Register, multilingual adverse media (LV / EN / RU / ET).
features.annexBody: P2 (client identification & due diligence), P3.1 (client risk assessment), and P3.2 (enhanced due diligence) — Latvian Bar Association templates auto-populated from each verdict. Drop straight into your client file.

captions.analysis: Transparent risk scoring with category-weighted breakdown — every contribution traced to source.
captions.checks: Multi-source coverage in one screening — every database check, status, and timestamp captured.
captions.summary: Audit-ready summary with pre-filled compliance documentation — drop straight into the client file.

cta.title: Want a 20-minute walk-through?
cta.body: We're running pricing-validation calls with LV and EU compliance buyers through May. Book a 20-minute demo and we'll walk through your firm's specific use case — or run a real screening yourself in the interactive demo.

metadata.title: Klirs — Audit-ready AML screening
metadata.description: Audit-ready AML/KYC screening for Latvian and EU compliance. Open-source engine, hosted at klirs.eu.
